description: Variation of Condition 1 of planning permission dated 16 October 2023 (RN: 23/05842/FULL), which itself varied planning permission dated 22 December 2022 (RN: 22/06621/FULL) for: Reconfiguration of two residential units to form one unit within Nos. 25, 26 and 48; and new residential unit within No. 49; installation of four condenser units, two on each of the roofs of Nos. 25 and 26; and extension at rear third and fourth floor level of No. 25 and associated works (site includes 25-26 Chester Square and 49-48 Eaton Mews South). NAMLEY, to allow works to front lower ground floor including new York stone paving to lightwell with single step below external staircase, new timber sash window with sidelights, new security railings to both windows in lightwell at no. 25, to match no. 26 existing railings; new York stone paving at no. 26, lightwell, and new Portland stone to both no. 25 and no. 26; rear elevation works include new glazing and glazing bar layout to external door to rear elevation, omit proposed screen between 25 and 26 terraces, new metal railings  to coping at no. 25 terrace, and new double dormer; new front door, garage gate and associated fanlights at no. 48.
